description: Workspace tools and GitHub sign-in for JBro Script Editor.
layoutEnabled: Use the JBro menu bar instead of the standard title bar tools. Standard menu and Activity Bar visibility are controlled separately.
workspaceEmpty:
Open a folder in the workspace.
[Open Folder](command:jbro.project.openFolder)
engineControlPort: Loopback control port of the engine editor.
debugProcessName: The scene editor executable name to attach to.
debugProcessId: The process id to attach to; used before the name when given.
debugScriptModules: Name prefixes of the DLLs treated as script modules.
debugSymbolPath: Where to find symbols (PDB). Empty means the adapter folder.
debugAttachSnippet: JBro: Attach to the scene editor
debugAttachSnippetDesc: Attach to the running scene editor without stopping it and debug scripts.
debugAdapterPath: Path to the JBroDebugAdapter executable. Empty looks next to the extension and on PATH.
